allyofjusticeunknowncrusher.name: Ally of Justice Unknown Crusher
allyofjusticeunknowncrusher.desc: When this card battles a LIGHT monster, remove that monster from play after damage calculation.

altergeistmeluseek.name: Altergeist Meluseek
altergeistmeluseek.desc: This card can attack directly. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; send it to the GY. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Altergeist" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Altergeist Meluseek". You can only use this effect of "Altergeist Meluseek" once per turn.

altergeistrevitalization.name: Altergeist Revitalization
altergeistrevitalization.desc: Target 1 "Altergeist" Link Monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Altergeist" monster. You can only use 1 "Altergeist Revitalization" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

ancientgearmegatongolem.name: Ancient Gear Megaton Golem
ancientgearmegatongolem.desc:
3 "Ancient Gear" monsters
If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card was Fusion Summoned using 2 or more "Ancient Gear Golem" and/or "Ancient Gear Golem - Ultimate Pound" as material, it can attack up to that many times during each Battle Phase. If this face-up Fusion Summoned card in its owner's control leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem" from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

archlordzerato.name: Archlord Zerato
archlordzerato.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on your side of the field, by discarding 1 LIGHT Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

fishandkicks.name: Fish and Kicks
fishandkicks.desc: If you have 3 or more banished Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monsters: Target 1 card on the field; banish it.

frostosaurus.name: Frostosaurus
frostosaurus.desc: This monster's metabolism enables it to endure long periods of cold, harnessing the power to become a creature of solid ice! Nothing else can withstand such temperatures, especially victims of its glacial rampage.

galaxywizard.name: Galaxy Wizard
galaxywizard.desc: Once per turn: You can increase this card's Level by 4 until the end of this turn. You can Tribute this card; add 1 "Galaxy" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Galaxy Wizard".

herospirit.name: Hero Spirit
herospirit.desc: During the Battle Phase, if an "Elemental HERO" monster you controlled was destroyed by battle this turn: Make the Battle Damage from 1 of your opponent's monsters 0.

inzektorswordzektkaliber.name: Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber
inzektorswordzektkaliber.desc: Equip only to an "Inzektor" monster. It gains 800 ATK and DEF. When this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 "Inzektor" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

mechadogmarron.name: Mecha-Dog Marron
mechadogmarron.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 1000 damage to both players. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard except by battle, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

mirrorwall.name: Mirror Wall
mirrorwall.desc: Each of your opponent's monsters that conducted an attack while this card was face-up on the field has its ATK halved as long as this card remains on the field. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 2000 LP or destroy this card.

numberc1numeronchaosgatesunya.name: Number C1: Numeron Chaos Gate Sunya
numberc1numeronchaosgatesunya.desc:
4 Level 2 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using "Number 1: Numeron Gate Ekam" you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) If this card is Xyz Summoned: Banish all monsters on the field. Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card was banished: You can Special Summon this banished card, then if "Numeron Network" is in your Field Zone, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined ATK of all banished Xyz Monsters.

orderofthequeen.name: Order of the Queen
orderofthequeen.desc: While you control "Amazoness Queen", negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by battle with attacking "Amazoness" monsters you control.

revivalrose.name: Revival Rose
revivalrose.desc: If a Level 5 or higher Plant-Type monster you control is destroyed, you can Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

salamangreatsunlightwolf.name: Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf
salamangreatsunlightwolf.desc:
2 FIRE Effect Monsters
If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to the zone(s) this card points to (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 FIRE monster from your GY to your hand, but for the rest of this turn, you cannot Normal Summon/Set or Special Summon monsters with the added monster's name. During your Main Phase, if you control this card that was Link Summoned using "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" as material: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf" once per turn.

slimetoken.name: Slime Token
slimetoken.desc:
This card can be used as a "Slime Token".


*If used for another Token, apply that Token's Type/Attribute/Level/ATK/DEF.

smileworld.name: Smile World
smileworld.desc: All face-up monsters currently on the field gain 100 ATK for each monster currently on the field, until the end of this turn.

sylvanprincessprout.name: Sylvan Princessprout
sylvanprincessprout.desc:
You can only activate each effect of "Sylvan Princessprout" once per turn.
● You can Tribute this card; excavate the top card of your Deck, send it to the Graveyard, then you can place 1 "sprout" monster in your Graveyard on top of your Deck.
● If this card is excavated from the Deck and sent to the Graveyard by a card effect: You can declare a Level from 1 to 8; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard, and if you do, it becomes that Level.

vernusylphandtheflowerbuds.name: Vernusylph and the Flower Buds
vernusylphandtheflowerbuds.desc: Target face-up cards your opponent controls, up to the number of EARTH monsters you control with different names that were Special Summoned from the GY; return EARTH monsters you control to the hand equal to the number of targets, and if you returned at least 1 to the hand, return the targeted cards to the hand. You can only activate 1 "Vernusylph and the Flower Buds" per turn.

visionheropoisoner.name: Vision HERO Poisoner
visionheropoisoner.desc: If you take battle or effect damage while this card is in your GY: You can place this card from your GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. During the Main Phase, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: You can Tribute 1 "HERO" monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone: You can halve the ATK of 1 face-up monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Vision HERO Poisoner" once per turn.

waltztoken.name: Waltz Token
waltztoken.desc: Special Summoned with the effect of "Battle Waltz". Neither player takes battle damage from battles involving this Token.

wormhope.name: Worm Hope
wormhope.desc:
FLIP: When this card is flipped face-up by an opponent's monster's attack, draw 1 card.
When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard.
